hero.title: AI Bookmark Organizer
hero.tagline: Auto-organize bookmarks with AI. Semantic classification, zero migration, privacy-first.
hero.subtitle: Use your own OpenAI-compatible API. No subscription, data stays local.

zeroMigration.title: Zero migration
zeroMigration.description: Works directly with Chrome native bookmarks. No export, no third-party sync—your existing bookmarks stay where they are.

semantic.title: AI semantic classification
semantic.description: Real content understanding, not keyword matching. Flat structure (category → subcategory), Inbox and Archive built in.

privacy.title: Privacy-first, your API
privacy.description: Data stays on your device. You bring your own OpenAI-compatible API—including self-hosted or local models. No subscription.

howItWorks.title: How it works
howItWorks.step1: Install the extension from Chrome Web Store
howItWorks.step2: Configure your API (base URL, key, model)
howItWorks.step4: AI classifies and moves them into the right folder
